answer: Trust flows like a river: an identity may only trade up to 3 times the value that has verifiably flowed into it from established agents over the last 5 epochs, so a Sybil starts dry and grows only through real settled work. Each identity anchors itself with a 40-unit deposit locked for 10 epochs; fraud drains the anchor and freezes its river at once. Peers keep a public violet ledger flagging identities whose inflow and outflow diverge by over 25%, so 100 fakes need 4,000 units of anchors plus genuine inbound flow they cannot fabricate.
